nodes.label: Offline-first mobile layer (drift outbox)
nodes.rationale: app_database.dart (drift tables: game sessions, actions, reminder events, sync outbox, routines) + offline_sync_service.dart + reminder_scheduler.dart make the patient app work on spotty NER networks. syncNow replays queued game sessions (start->actions->complete) and reminder acks via the live API, pushes generic payloads to POST /api/v1/sync, and purges synced outbox rows after 7 days. Requires build_runner codegen of app_database.g.dart (not committed).
